items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: that was Loesser, Frank Loesser's tune... Frank Loesser was a personal friend of Barney Josephson's

ctx.x: I see. And there was another -- "The Lady's in Love With You," did rather well too, didn't it?
Well, that was Loesser, Frank Loesser's tune. That was the B side of --
Oh, that was on the other side of, "Hurry On Down."
